name: UGCraft
tagline: Create Roblox-ready outfits and accessories from prompts or reference images, without Blender.
description: UGCraft is an AI Roblox UGC creator. Describe an accessory or outfit in text or upload a reference image; AI builds a marketplace-ready 3D item without Blender. Clothing Maker creates layered 3D clothing from text or image and exports FBX/GLB for fitting in Roblox Studio with the Accessory Fitting Tool. Accessory Maker creates hats, hair, wings and gear in the browser and exports .rbxm/.fbx. It also offers Shirt Maker, R15 Emote Maker, Animation Maker, Cage Generator, free Clothing Tester, UGC Checker, UGC Ideas and templates. The free plan includes 20 credits for non-commercial use with a watermark; paid tiers include commercial rights and no watermark. Creator is $9/mo billed yearly ($15 monthly); Pro is $18/mo billed yearly ($30 monthly).
